purpose: Live scalar-oracle equivalence corpus for the complete distributed algebra lane

cases.query: SELECT * WHERE { { ?s ?p ?o } UNION { ?s a ?t } MINUS { ?s a <urn:never> } } LIMIT 100
SELECT ?p (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } GROUP BY ?p ORDER BY DESC(?count) LIMIT 100
SELECT DISTINCT ?s WHERE { { SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } LIMIT 1000 } } ORDER BY ?s LIMIT 100
